description: Mid-America Apartment Communities, Inc., an S&P 500 company, is a multifamily-focused, self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust that owns, operates, acquires and selectively develops apartment communities primarily located in the Southeast, Southwest and Mid-Atlantic regions of the U.S. As of December 31, 2025 it maintained full or partial ownership of 302 apartment communities, including communities currently in development, across 16 states and the District of Columbia, comprising 103,083 units, of which 301 multifamily communities and 102,814 units were consolidated and one community with 269 units was unconsolidated. Its business is conducted principally through the Operating Partnership, of which it is the sole general partner holding 116,878,077 OP Units, comprising a 97.5 percent partnership interest as of December 31, 2025, and MAA and MAALP were formed in Tennessee in 1993. Its primary business objectives are to generate a sustainable, stable and increasing cash flow that will fund its dividends and distributions through all parts of the real estate investment cycle.
